==Description==
'''Jolly Tree''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by SoupedGun, MonoGAnim and Vylith. The emote is looped and players can move while performing this emote. No music can be heard while performing this emote and it cannot be interacted with.

'''Jolly Tree''' will spawn in a large Christmas tree, to which the player will jump into. After a second, the players head will pop out of the Christmas tree. The player is then able to freely move in the Christmas tree, hopping instead of walking. A sound effect is played after every hop.

This emote could be obtained at Level 1 of the premium track, where it costs {{Bell|30}} or {{Robux|32}}.

==Trivia==
*Due to a bug within the inventory emote preview, you can view how your avatar actually looks while inside the tree, and all of your body parts (except for you head) are disformed to be able to fit inside the Christmas tree without poking out.
